description:
Read a recheck from schedule_recheck. Before it runs: status and run_at. After: per prompt and engine, baseline vs recheck — citations (brand URL in sources) and mentions gained or lost.

Billing: free — reads stored results only; asks no engine and works at a zero balance.

When to call: when asked whether fixes worked, or once run_at has passed. recheck_id reads one; site_id/domain lists the site's; nothing lists the workspace's.

Status: scheduled | queued | running | complete | failed | paused (site archived; it won't run).

Returns { recheck_id, status, headline (relay it), site_id, domain, run_at, ran_at, prompts, engines, baseline, audit_id, report_url, failure_reason, out_of_credits, answered, total, charged_cents, summary: {compared_cells, cited_before, cited_after, mentioned_before, mentioned_after, citation_gained: [{prompt, engine}], citation_lost, mention_gained, mention_lost, no_baseline}, results: [{prompt, engines: [{engine, before, after, after_error, citation, mention}]}] }. citation / mention: gained | lost | kept | still_missing, null if a side has no answer. A list: { rechecks: [{recheck_id, status, domain, run_at, ran_at, prompt_count, audit_id}] }.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

name: get_recheck
title: Get a recheck's status and before-vs-after citation changes
